title: Frog Squat
instructions: Grab a dumbbell with both hands and rest it in front of you, between your legs.
Position your feet wider than shoulder-width, with toes pointing outward at a 45-degree angle.
Brace your core and maintain a straight back. This is the starting position.
Lower your hips towards the ground as far as possible or at least until your thighs are parallel with the floor by bending your knees, and keeping your chest up.
Push through your heels to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top. This is one rep.
tips: During the squat movement, your arms should be fully extended, holding the dumbbell down between your legs.
Maintain an upright chest and neutral spine—avoid rounding your back.
Move slowly and with control, focusing on proper form to avoid strain.
